# BrushAlpha <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Brushes](Blitz3D-Brushes)

</div>


```blitzbasic
BrushAlpha:Void brush:Int32, alpha:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `brush` | In | Int32 | required | The brush. |
| `alpha` | In | Float32 | required | Opacity, 0 to 1. The default is 1. |

## Description

Sets how see-through painted surfaces are. 1 is solid, 0 is invisible and values between give glass-like surfaces. Values outside 0 to 1 are clamped.

A surface with alpha 0 is not drawn but still takes part in collisions, which is the difference to [HideEntity](HideEntity).
